description.value: Accent Inn Kelowna is a family-owned BC motel in downtown Kelowna running a dedicated 'Bike Love' program that treats cyclists as first-class guests rather than an afterthought. Touring cyclists can bring their bike directly into their room, access a professional-grade 37-piece tool kit, and use an on-site bicycle wash and tuning station. The hotel is Rainbow Registered, pet-friendly, and sits within a 20-minute drive of over 40 Okanagan wineries with abundant trail and beach access nearby.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's dedicated /about-us/bike-friendly/ page provides strong, specific evidence for the Bike Love program: bikes are explicitly allowed in guest rooms ('Love your bike? Bring it to your room'), front desk staff handle bike-room requests and route advice, a 37-piece tool kit and bicycle wash/tuning station are offered at every Accent Inns location. Laundry facilities, free in-room WiFi, and an on-site restaurant (Ricky's All Day Grill, serving breakfast/lunch/dinner) are confirmed on the main Kelowna page. OSM phone and website match the website exactly; the website address adds '#2' to the unit number not present in OSM.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM has '1140 Harvey Avenue' but the website shows '1140 Harvey Ave #2, Kelowna, BC'. The website value (with unit #2) is used here; OSM should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Strong WWC fit: the hotel runs a formal, well-documented bike program (bikes in rooms, 37-piece tool kit, wash station, staff-assisted bike room booking and route advice) purpose-built for touring and recreational cyclists across all its BC locations.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free bike rentals are also offered to guests who did not bring their own bicycle, which may be worth highlighting in directory copy.
